title: Critique: no sign that the cosmos is conscious, and no test

statements.text: Attributing consciousness to the cosmos is counterintuitive, the cosmos lacks the structure of a brain, nothing shows that it is conscious, and no empirical test could prove it. Nagasawa and Wager reply that each objection applies equally to panpsychism, since physical ultimates also lack brain structure and show no sign of consciousness.
